The implementation perfectly matches the Acceptance Criteria:
1. `cargo test --lib --no-run` will now compile out-of-tree because missing paths are no longer statically required at compile time.
2. `contract_or_skip` and `fixture` helper functions check for the existence of `contracts/` and `tests/fixtures/` respectively to determine if they are running in-tree or out-of-tree. If out-of-tree, they gracefully print a `SKIP` message with the test name and return `None`. If in-tree, they attempt to read the file and panic explicitly if the file is missing, satisfying "in tree a missing file fails".

No negative regressions or deviations from the ticket were found.
